items.title: Microsoft Releases .NET 11 RC1 with Go-Live Support, C# 15 and F# 11 as Default Language Versions
items.blurb: Last week, Microsoft has released .NET 11 Release Candidate 1, the first release candidate of the cycle, shipping with a go-live support license for production use.

items.title: Amazon Linux 2027 Enters Public Preview with SELinux Enforcing by Default
items.blurb: AWS has released Amazon Linux 2027 in public preview, built on the AL2023 baseline with kernel 7.1 and SELinux in enforcing mode by default. Applications that pass on AL2023's permissive mode may fail under enforcing.

items.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: NVIDIA's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 and Alibaba's Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: AWS Glue zero-ETL adds target table property ownership and conflict detection
items.blurb: AWS Glue zero-ETL integrations now detect table property conflicts and track integration ownership.

items.title: AWS End User Messaging now supports Dynamic Flows in WhatsApp
items.blurb: AWS End User Messaging now supports dynamic WhatsApp flows so you can turn WhatsApp conversations into rich, interactive experiences that end-users complete directly in WhatsApp.
